# 4SAPI — Unified LLM API Gateway

> One API key, one OpenAI-compatible endpoint, every major LLM provider (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, DeepSeek, Qwen, and more). Point your existing OpenAI SDK client at https://4sapi.com/v1 and swap the model name — no new SDK, no new auth flow, no rewritten request bodies.

4SAPI is a unified LLM API gateway built by the 4SAPI team. It exposes a single OpenAI-compatible endpoint that routes to OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, DeepSeek, Qwen, and other major providers, handling routing, provider auth, and format translation behind the scenes. This repository (4sapi-docs) hosts 300+ practical guides covering client integration, coding-agent workflows (Claude Code, Codex, Fable5, GLM, Kimi K3, and more), troubleshooting runbooks, and enterprise cost/governance practices — all centered on 4SAPI as the routing layer.

## Getting Started
- [README — Quick Start & How It Works](https://github.com/4sapi/4sapi-docs#readme): OpenAI SDK 接入示例、路由架构图、支持的模型清单
- [Website](https://4sapi.com): 4SAPI 官网
- [API Docs](https://4sapi.apifox.cn/8181987m0): 完整接口文档与操作说明
- [Blog](https://4sapi.com/blog): 产品博客
